test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which word is nearest in meaning to shamefacedly?

The father laughed shamefacedly at the son's outburst.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Embarrassedly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"shamefacedly"** means feeling or showing shame or embarrassment. (शर्मिंदा होकर)
 
 
• **Example:** He admitted his mistake shamefacedly in front of the entire team.
 

 
• **"Embarrassedly"** refers to feeling self-conscious or awkward due to shame or discomfort. (शर्मिंदा होकर)
 
 
• **Example:** She smiled embarrassedly as she realized her mistake during the presentation.
 

 
• In the given sentence, the father laugh
